messages:
maya: FYI: partner proxy traffic is being billed to the proxy org, while console usage shows the partner project. that's confusing finance. anyone seen this?
own: seen it during integration tests. token-exchange drops original origin claim so downstream only sees proxy identity.
lee: is the exchange flow intentionally normalizing claims or is it a bug?
maya: by design it mints a proxy-scoped token and doesn't copy origin metadata. we relied on direct calls previously.
sam: quick mitigation: have proxy emit a telemetry-only header `x-origin-id` so console can show inferred attribution while we design a secure solution.
kevin: we can't trust headers for billing/enforcement. two secure designs: (1) partners sign an `origin` claim we verify (signed-origin), or (2) exchange service records exchange_id->origin and routing does a fast lookup on exchange_id.
own: mapping (2) is low-friction for partners but requires a very low-latency cache in the routing path. signed-origin avoids lookup but requires partner key management.
lee: for quota enforcement we need the project at request time. mapping must target p50<1ms, p99<10ms to avoid request tail. otherwise enforce-on-proxy + "would-have" metrics is safer for canary.
maya: proposed rollout: phase 0: telemetry-only (1% sample, 14d), phase 1: console "Inferred origin (exchange-id)" toggle + reconciliation card, phase 2: canary mapping for partner ID "partner-omega" in eu-central-1 with 5% sampling and monitoring, phase 3: optional signed-origin pilot.
kevin: I'll add metrics: `auth.exchange.lookup_req`, `auth.exchange.lookup_hit`, `auth.exchange.lookup_miss`, `auth.exchange.lookup_latency_ms`, and `auth.billing.reconcile_pct`. will build a dashboard and alert rules.
sam: canary playbook: partner=partner-omega, region=eu-central-1, sample=5%, alert on reconcile_pct>2% sustained 30m or cache_miss>1% for 15m. rollback if request p95 latency increases >40ms.
own: I'll prototype a local LRU cache with redis fallback and TTL=3m. will post benchmark numbers tomorrow. add feature flag `auth.exchange.map_origin=false` to gate rollout.
lee: console copy: add help bubble "Why billed org may differ" and an explainer card linking to the reconciliation view.
auth-bot: deploy started: svc-auth-exchange v3.3.0 -> canary eu-central-1 (1/3).
maya: thanks, I'll write the short rollout note and notify partner success. :thumbsup:
